services.note: the three national networks closed GSM between 2016 and 2018; the year is from memory (unconfirmed). The railways of Australia run GSM-R in the 1800 MHz band (downlink 1865 to 1880 MHz, per secondary sources), outside the 860 to 960 MHz that the stack tunes, so no channel of the stack remains
